________ test_clone_order_survives_independent_post_consumer_overwrite _________

    def test_clone_order_survives_independent_post_consumer_overwrite():
        tir = tvm.tirx
        a = tir.decl_buffer((8,), "int32", name="ordered_A")
        b = tir.decl_buffer((8,), "int32", name="ordered_B")
        k = tir.Var("k", "int32")
        value = tir.Var("ordered_value", "int32")
        statements = [
            tir.BufferStore(a, 1, [k]),
            tir.Bind(value, tir.BufferLoad(a, [k]) + 1),
            tir.BufferStore(b, value, [k]),
            # This independent task follows the consumer in the original body but
            # is scheduled between the clone and consumer in the augmented order.
            tir.BufferStore(a, 99, [k]),
        ]
        annotations = _annotations(latencies=[1] * 4, iis=[1] * 4, resource_flags=[0] * 4)
        func = _make_statement_func(statements, [a, b], annotations, k)
    
        def solver_result(call):
            starts = {
                # The pre-clone scalar WAR edge (2, 1, 1, 1) requires
                # start(consumer) <= start(definition) + II - latency.
                4: [0, 1, 16, 17],
                5: [0, 1, 20, 19, 18],
            }
            return starts[len(call["latencies"])], [], 16
    
        calls = _install_solver(solver_result)
        planned = _run_z3(func)
        loop = _find_loop(planned["main"])
        assert len(calls) == 2
        plan = _clone_plan(loop)
        assert len(plan) == 1
        clone_task = 4
        assert [clone_task, 3, 0, 1] in _nested_ints(calls[1]["data_deps"])
        assert int(plan[0]["schedule_position"]) == 2
        assert int(plan[0]["consumer_schedule_position"]) == 4
        assert _ints(loop.annotations["tl_pipeline_order"]) == [0, 1, 4, 3]

            tir.Bind(z, x + 2),

                9: [1, 4, 8, 12, 16, 67, 66, 65, 65],
                10: [1, 4, 8, 12, 16, 67, 66, 65, 65, 64],
            }
            return starts[len(call["latencies"])], [], 64

        assert len(plan) == 4

        assert set(by_definition) == {1, 2, 3, 4}
        assert sum(int(entry["definition_task"]) == 1 for entry in plan) == 1
        assert all(int(entry["consumer_task"]) == 5 for entry in plan)
        assert set(_ints(by_definition[4]["scalar_inputs"])) == {7, 8}

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("alias_storage", [True, False])
    def test_aliased_views_keep_clone_raw_war_constraints_and_versions(alias_storage):
        """Cross-iteration view aliases must not disappear from inference or clones."""
        tir = tvm.tirx
        written = tir.decl_buffer((8,), "int32", name="dependency_written_view", scope="shared")
        write = written
        if alias_storage:
            read = tir.decl_buffer(
                (8,), "int32", name="dependency_aliased_view", data=written.data, scope="shared"
            )
            write = tir.decl_buffer(
                (8,), "int32", name="dependency_aliased_write_view", data=written.data, scope="shared"
            )
        else:
            read = tir.decl_buffer((8,), "int32", name="dependency_disjoint_view")
        out = tir.decl_buffer((8,), "int32", name="dependency_view_out")
        k = tir.Var("k", "int32")
        value = tir.Var("dependency_view_value", "int32")
        statements = [
            tir.BufferStore(write, 1, [k]),
            # Reading the canonical written Buffer keeps this Bind scheduled in both
            # cases. Without alias storage, its W[k] accesses are disjoint across
            # iterations, so only the additional views can introduce cross-iteration
            # RAW/WAR here.
            tir.Bind(value, tir.BufferLoad(read, [k]) + tir.BufferLoad(written, [k])),
            tir.BufferStore(out, value, [k]),
        ]
        annotations = _complete_annotations([2, 3, 4])
        annotations.pop("tl_z3_pipeline_data_deps")
        annotations.pop("tl_z3_pipeline_buffer_sizes")
        annotations.pop("tl_z3_pipeline_buffer_vars")
        annotations.update(
            {
                "tl_z3_pipeline_manual_schedule": True,
                "tl_z3_pipeline_manual_stages": _imms([0, 0, 1]),
                "tl_z3_pipeline_enable_offset": True,
            }
        )
        buffers = [written, out] if alias_storage else [written, read, out]
        inferred = _run_infer(

        for dependency in original_raw_war:
            assert (list(dependency) in dependencies) == alias_storage

        calls = []

            calls.append(args)
            return solver(*args)

    def test_inject_software_pipeline_checks_cross_thread_raw_reordering(stages, orders, offset, thread_form):

    def test_async_pipeline_multi_stage_rejects_buffer_changing_commit_group():
        @T.prim_func
        def before(
            A: T.Tensor((16, 12), T.float32),
            X: T.Tensor((16, 12), T.float32),
            B: T.Tensor((16, 12), T.float32),
            C: T.Tensor((16, 12), T.float32),
        ):
            for tx in T.thread_binding(0, 16, thread="threadIdx.x"):
                a_shared = T.alloc_buffer((16, 1), dtype=T.float32, scope="shared")
                x_shared = T.alloc_buffer((16, 1), dtype=T.float32, scope="shared")
                b_shared = T.alloc_buffer((16, 1), dtype=T.float32, scope="shared")
                for i in T.serial(
                    0,
                    12,
                    annotations={
                        "software_pipeline_stage": [0, 0, 0, 1, 2],
                        "software_pipeline_order": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4],
                        "software_pipeline_async_stages": [0, 1],
                        "software_pipeline_async_producers": [1, 1, 1, 1, 0],
                        "software_pipeline_async_producer_groups": [0, 1, 0, 0, -1],
                        "num_stages": 3,
                    },
                ):
                    with T.sblock("copy_a"):
                        T.reads(A[tx, i])
                        T.writes(a_shared[tx, 0])
                        a_shared[tx, 0] = A[tx, i]
                    with T.sblock("copy_x"):
                        T.reads(X[tx, i])
                        T.writes(x_shared[tx, 0])
                        x_shared[tx, 0] = X[tx, i]
                    with T.sblock("copy_x_again"):
                        T.reads(X[tx, i])
                        T.writes(x_shared[tx, 0])
                        x_shared[tx, 0] = X[tx, i] + T.float32(1)
                    with T.sblock("copy_b"):
                        T.reads(B[tx, i])
                        T.writes(b_shared[tx, 0])
                        b_shared[tx, 0] = B[tx, i]
                    with T.sblock("consume"):
                        T.reads(a_shared[tx, 0], x_shared[tx, 0], b_shared[tx, 0])
                        T.writes(C[tx, i])
                        C[tx, i] = a_shared[tx, 0] + x_shared[tx, 0] + b_shared[tx, 0]

    def test_inject_software_pipeline_sibling_buffers(first, second, flat_alloc):

        @T.prim_func

                shared = allocate((8, 16), T.float16, scope="shared.dyn")

                for k in T.serial(
                    8,
                    annotations={"software_pipeline_stage": [0, first - 1], "software_pipeline_order": [0, 1]},
                ):
                    with T.sblock("load_first"):
                        T.reads(A[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(shared[0:8, 0:16])

                    with T.sblock("store_first"):
                        T.reads(shared[0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(B[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        for i, j in T.grid(8, 16):
                            B[k, i, j] = shared[i, j]
                for k in T.serial(
                    8,
                    16,
                    annotations={"software_pipeline_stage": [0, second - 1], "software_pipeline_order": [0, 1]},
                ):
                    with T.sblock("load_second"):

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("flat_alloc", [False, True])
    def test_inject_software_pipeline_sibling_buffers(first, second, flat_alloc):
        layout = Layout([8, 16], lambda i, j: i * 16 + j)
        allocate = T.alloc_buffer if flat_alloc else T.sblock_alloc_buffer
    
        @T.prim_func
        def before(A: T.Tensor((16, 8, 16), T.float16), B: T.Tensor((16, 8, 16), T.float16)):
            with T.sblock("root"):
                shared = allocate((8, 16), T.float16, scope="shared.dyn")
                T.annotate_layout({shared: layout})
                for k in T.serial(
                    8,
                    annotations={"software_pipeline_stage": [0, first - 1], "software_pipeline_order": [0, 1]},
                ):
                    with T.sblock("load_first"):
                        T.reads(A[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(shared[0:8, 0:16])
                        for i, j in T.grid(8, 16):
                            shared[i, j] = A[k, i, j]
                    with T.sblock("store_first"):
                        T.reads(shared[0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(B[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        for i, j in T.grid(8, 16):
                            B[k, i, j] = shared[i, j]
                for k in T.serial(
                    8,
                    16,
                    annotations={"software_pipeline_stage": [0, second - 1], "software_pipeline_order": [0, 1]},
                ):
                    with T.sblock("load_second"):
                        T.reads(A[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(shared[0:8, 0:16])
                        for i, j in T.grid(8, 16):
                            shared[i, j] = A[k, i, j]

                        T.writes(B[k, 0:8, 0:16])

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("first,second", [(2, 4), (4, 2), (3, 1), (1, 3), (3, 3)])
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("flat_alloc", [False, True])
    def test_inject_software_pipeline_sibling_buffers(first, second, flat_alloc):
        layout = Layout([8, 16], lambda i, j: i * 16 + j)
        allocate = T.alloc_buffer if flat_alloc else T.sblock_alloc_buffer
    
        @T.prim_func
        def before(A: T.Tensor((16, 8, 16), T.float16), B: T.Tensor((16, 8, 16), T.float16)):
            with T.sblock("root"):
                shared = allocate((8, 16), T.float16, scope="shared.dyn")
                T.annotate_layout({shared: layout})
                for k in T.serial(
                    8,
                    annotations={"software_pipeline_stage": [0, first - 1], "software_pipeline_order": [0, 1]},
                ):
                    with T.sblock("load_first"):
                        T.reads(A[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(shared[0:8, 0:16])
                        for i, j in T.grid(8, 16):
                            shared[i, j] = A[k, i, j]
                    with T.sblock("store_first"):
                        T.reads(shared[0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(B[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        for i, j in T.grid(8, 16):
                            B[k, i, j] = shared[i, j]
                for k in T.serial(
                    8,
                    16,
                    annotations={"software_pipeline_stage": [0, second - 1], "software_pipeline_order": [0, 1]},
                ):
                    with T.sblock("load_second"):
                        T.reads(A[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(shared[0:8, 0:16])
                        for i, j in T.grid(8, 16):
                            shared[i, j] = A[k, i, j]
                    with T.sblock("store_second"):
                        T.reads(shared[0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(B[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        for i, j in T.grid(8, 16):
                            B[k, i, j] = shared[i, j]
                # Ordinary scratch-buffer uses must also address the expanded view.
                shared[0, 0] = A[0, 0, 0]
                B[0, 0, 0] = shared[0, 0]

    def test_inject_software_pipeline_sibling_buffers(first, second, flat_alloc):
        layout = Layout([8, 16], lambda i, j: i * 16 + j)
        allocate = T.alloc_buffer if flat_alloc else T.sblock_alloc_buffer
    
        @T.prim_func
        def before(A: T.Tensor((16, 8, 16), T.float16), B: T.Tensor((16, 8, 16), T.float16)):
            with T.sblock("root"):
                shared = allocate((8, 16), T.float16, scope="shared.dyn")
                T.annotate_layout({shared: layout})
                for k in T.serial(
                    8,
                    annotations={"software_pipeline_stage": [0, first - 1], "software_pipeline_order": [0, 1]},
                ):
                    with T.sblock("load_first"):
                        T.reads(A[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(shared[0:8, 0:16])
                        for i, j in T.grid(8, 16):
                            shared[i, j] = A[k, i, j]
                    with T.sblock("store_first"):
                        T.reads(shared[0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(B[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        for i, j in T.grid(8, 16):
                            B[k, i, j] = shared[i, j]
                for k in T.serial(
                    8,
                    16,
                    annotations={"software_pipeline_stage": [0, second - 1], "software_pipeline_order": [0, 1]},
                ):
                    with T.sblock("load_second"):
                        T.reads(A[k, 0:8, 0:16])
                        T.writes(shared[0:8, 0:16])
                        for i, j in T.grid(8, 16):

____ test_pipeline_planning_bind_replay_uses_buffer_storage_identity[True] _____

alias_storage = True

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("alias_storage", [True, False])
    def test_pipeline_planning_bind_replay_uses_buffer_storage_identity(alias_storage):
        """A write through one view must prevent replay through an aliased view."""
        tir = tvm.tirx
        written = tir.decl_buffer((4,), "float32", name="written_view", scope="shared")
        if alias_storage:
            read = tir.decl_buffer(
                (4,), "float32", name="aliased_read_view", data=written.data, scope="shared"
            )
        else:
            read = tir.decl_buffer((4,), "float32", name="disjoint_read_only")
        out = tir.decl_buffer((4,), "float32", name="view_replay_out")
        snapshot = tir.Var("view_snapshot", "float32")
        k = tir.Var("k", "int32")
        statements = [
            tir.BufferStore(written, 1.0, [0]),
            # The consumer and a non-replayable Bind must share a stage. This
            # independent intervening overwrite makes replay at the consumer unsafe
            # exactly when the read view aliases the written storage.
            tir.Bind(snapshot, tir.BufferLoad(read, [0]) + 1.0),
            tir.BufferStore(written, 2.0, [0]),
            tir.BufferStore(out, snapshot, [k]),
        ]
        stages = [0, 1, 1, 1] if alias_storage else [0, 1, 1]
        orders = [0, 1, 2, 3] if alias_storage else [0, 1, 2]
        loop = tir.For(
            k,
            0,
            4,
            tir.ForKind.SERIAL,
            tir.SeqStmt(statements),
            annotations={
                "num_stages": tir.IntImm("int32", 2),
                # Use the explicit planner contract. Supplying only num_stages with
                # software_pipeline_* would instead request automatic replanning,
                # which puts these non-copy statements together in the last stage.
                "tl_pipeline_stage": stages,
                "tl_pipeline_order": orders,
            },
        )
        params = [out.data]
        buffer_map = {out.data: out}
        if not alias_storage:
            params.append(read.data)
            buffer_map[read.data] = read
        func = tir.PrimFunc(
            params,
            tir.SeqStmt([tir.AllocBuffer(written), loop]),
            buffer_map=buffer_map,
        ).with_attr("global_symbol", "main")

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda
    def test_pipeline_planning_propagates_buffer_producer_through_bind():
        """A copy's scalar index can depend transitively on a shared-buffer store."""
    
        @T.prim_func
        def before(
            A: T.Tensor((64,), T.float16),
            B: T.Tensor((64,), T.float16),
        ):
            with T.Kernel(1, threads=256):
                index_shared = T.alloc_shared((1,), T.int32)
                A_shared = T.alloc_shared((32,), T.float16)
                for k in T.Pipelined(2, num_stages=2):
                    index_shared[0] = k * 32
                    offset: T.int32 = index_shared[0]
                    T.copy(A[offset], A_shared)
                    for i in T.Parallel(32):
                        B[k * 32 + i] = A_shared[i]
    
        mod = _run_pipeline_planning(before, sm80_target)
        anno = _collect_pipeline_loop_annotations(mod["main"])[0]
        stages = [int(value) for value in anno["software_pipeline_stage"]]
        orders = [int(value) for value in anno["software_pipeline_order"]]
        assert stages == [0, 0, 0, 1]
        assert orders == [0, 1, 2, 3]

_______ test_pipeline_planning_does_not_propagate_disjoint_buffer_region _______

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda
    def test_pipeline_planning_does_not_propagate_disjoint_buffer_region():
        """A store to another region of the same buffer is not a copy producer."""
    
        @T.prim_func
        def before(
            A: T.Tensor((64,), T.float16),
            B: T.Tensor((64,), T.float16),
        ):
            with T.Kernel(1, threads=256):
                index_shared = T.alloc_shared((2,), T.int32)
                A_shared = T.alloc_shared((32,), T.float16)
                for k in T.Pipelined(2, num_stages=2):
                    index_shared[1] = k
                    index_shared[0] = k * 32
                    offset: T.int32 = index_shared[0]
                    T.copy(A[offset], A_shared)
                    for i in T.Parallel(32):
                        B[k * 32 + i] = A_shared[i]
    
        mod = _run_pipeline_planning(before, sm80_target)
        anno = _collect_pipeline_loop_annotations(mod["main"])[0]
        stages = [int(value) for value in anno["software_pipeline_stage"]]
        orders = [int(value) for value in anno["software_pipeline_order"]]
        assert stages == [1, 0, 0, 0, 1]
        assert orders == [3, 0, 1, 2, 4]

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("threads_x,threads_y", [(32, 1), (8, 4)])
    def test_pipeline_planning_keeps_disjoint_thread_copy_regions(threads_x, threads_y):
        @T.prim_func
        def before(A: T.Tensor((128,), T.float32), B: T.Tensor((128,), T.float32)):

                    shared[tx + threads_x * ty + 32] = A[k * 64 + tx + threads_x * ty + 32]
                    B[k * 64 + tx + threads_x * ty] = shared[tx + threads_x * ty]
                    B[k * 64 + tx + threads_x * ty + 32] = shared[tx + threads_x * ty + 32]

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda

    def test_pipeline_planning_tracks_cross_thread_index_producers(materialize_launch):

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda
    def test_pipeline_planning_reaches_mixed_dependency_fixed_point():
        """Alternating scalar and buffer edges propagate to arbitrary depth."""
    
        @T.prim_func
        def before(
            A: T.Tensor((64,), T.float16),
            B: T.Tensor((64,), T.float16),
        ):
            with T.Kernel(1, threads=256):
                index_0 = T.alloc_shared((1,), T.int32)
                index_1 = T.alloc_shared((1,), T.int32)
                A_shared = T.alloc_shared((32,), T.float16)
                for k in T.Pipelined(2, num_stages=2):
                    index_0[0] = k * 32
                    base: T.int32 = index_0[0]
                    index_1[0] = base
                    offset: T.int32 = index_1[0]
                    T.copy(A[offset], A_shared)
                    for i in T.Parallel(32):
                        B[k * 32 + i] = A_shared[i]
    
        mod = _run_pipeline_planning(before, sm80_target)
        anno = _collect_pipeline_loop_annotations(mod["main"])[0]
        stages = [int(value) for value in anno["software_pipeline_stage"]]

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda
    def test_pipeline_planning_redirects_copy_anchor_through_copy_producer():
        """A copy feeding another copy's index joins the downstream copy group."""
    
        @T.prim_func
        def before(
            indices: T.Tensor((2,), T.int32),
            A: T.Tensor((64,), T.float16),
            B: T.Tensor((64,), T.float16),
        ):
            with T.Kernel(1, threads=256):
                index_shared = T.alloc_shared((1,), T.int32)
                A_shared = T.alloc_shared((32,), T.float16)
                for k in T.Pipelined(2, num_stages=2):
                    T.copy(indices[k], index_shared)
                    offset: T.int32 = index_shared[0]
                    T.copy(A[offset], A_shared)
                    for i in T.Parallel(32):
                        B[k * 32 + i] = A_shared[i]
    
        mod = _run_pipeline_planning(before, sm80_target)
        anno = _collect_pipeline_loop_annotations(mod["main"])[0]
        stages = [int(value) for value in anno["software_pipeline_stage"]]
        orders = [int(value) for value in anno["software_pipeline_order"]]
        assert stages == [0, 0, 0, 1]
        assert orders == [0, 1, 2, 3]
        async_groups = [int(value) for value in anno["software_pipeline_async_producer_groups"]]
        assert async_groups[0] >= 0
        assert async_groups[2] >= 0
        assert async_groups[0] != async_groups[2]

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda
    def test_pipeline_planning_resolves_each_multi_root_anchor_before_minimum():
        """A shared producer uses the earliest resolved sink across copy groups."""
    
        @T.prim_func
        def before(
            indices: T.Tensor((64,), T.int32),
            A: T.Tensor((64,), T.float16),
            C: T.Tensor((64,), T.float16),
            B: T.Tensor((128,), T.float16),
        ):
            with T.Kernel(1, threads=256):
                base_shared = T.alloc_shared((1,), T.int32)
                A_shared = T.alloc_shared((32,), T.float16)
                next_shared = T.alloc_shared((1,), T.int32)
                C_shared = T.alloc_shared((32,), T.float16)
                for k in T.Pipelined(2, num_stages=2):
                    base_shared[0] = k * 32
                    base: T.int32 = base_shared[0]
                    T.copy(A[base], A_shared)
                    T.copy(indices[base], next_shared)
                    next_base: T.int32 = next_shared[0]
                    for i in T.Parallel(32):
                        B[k * 64 + i] = A_shared[i]
                    T.copy(C[next_base], C_shared)
                    for i in T.Parallel(32):
                        B[k * 64 + 32 + i] = C_shared[i]
    
        mod = _run_pipeline_planning(before, sm80_target)
        anno = _collect_pipeline_loop_annotations(mod["main"])[0]
        stages = [int(value) for value in anno["software_pipeline_stage"]]
        orders = [int(value) for value in anno["software_pipeline_order"]]
        assert stages == [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 2]
        assert orders[1] < orders[2]
        assert orders[1] < orders[3]

    def test_nonzero_loop_base_phase():
        """A scope loop starting at a non-zero base counts pipeline phases from

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda
    def test_sequential_scope_loop_kinds():
        """Any sequential loop can be a schedule scope (T.Pipelined is a serial
        loop whose num_stages this pass consumes; a T.unroll scope keeps its

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda
    def test_op_node_loop():
        """A T.unroll loop with an id is one op node: inner statements need no
        ids, the loop keeps its kind, and its pipeline reads rebind to the
        acquired version."""
    
        @T.prim_func
        def kernel(A: T.Tensor((256, 64), T.float16), B: T.Tensor((256, 64), T.float16)):
            with T.Kernel(1, threads=128) as _:
                A_shared = T.alloc_shared((64, 64), T.float16)
                A_frag = T.alloc_fragment((64, 64), T.float16)
                T.annotate_ws_schedule(
                    T.WSSchedule(
                        num_warps=8,
                        roles=[
                            T.WSRole("Producer", warps_lo=0, warps_hi=1, max_nreg=40),
                            T.WSRole("Consumer", warps_lo=4, warps_hi=8, max_nreg=224),
                        ],
                        pipelines=[T.WSPipeline("buf", [A_shared], depth=2)],
                        scopes=[
                            T.WSScope(
                                "loop_k",
                                {
                                    "Producer": [
                                        T.WSSync.producer_acquire("buf"),
                                        "copy_in",
                                        T.WSSync.producer_commit("buf"),
                                    ],
                                    "Consumer": [
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_wait("buf"),
                                        "store_loop",
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_release("buf"),
                                    ],
                                },
                            ),
                            T.WSScope(T.WSScope.ROOT, {"Producer": ["loop_k"], "Consumer": ["loop_k"]}),
                        ],
                    )
                )
    
                for i in T.Pipelined(4, num_stages=2, annotations={T.WSID: "loop_k"}):
                    T.copy(A[i * 64, 0], A_shared, annotations={T.WSID: "copy_in"})
                    # The unrolled loop is one op node; its statements are
                    # unannotated and its A_shared read binds it to the pipeline.
                    for s in T.unroll(2, annotations={T.WSID: "store_loop"}):
                        T.copy(A_shared[:, s * 32 : (s + 1) * 32], A_frag[:, s * 32 : (s + 1) * 32])
                        T.copy(A_frag[:, s * 32 : (s + 1) * 32], B[i * 64, s * 32])

blockscaled = False

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("blockscaled", [False, True])
    def test_tcgen05_async_arrive_count(blockscaled):
        """A gemm accumulating into TMEM signals with tcgen05.commit: the full
        barrier of the accumulator pipeline gets arrive count 1, and the smem
        release below the gemm becomes a tcgen05_mma_arrive."""
        tile = 128 if blockscaled else 64
        dtype = T.float8_e4m3fn if blockscaled else T.float16
    
        @T.prim_func
        def kernel(A: T.Tensor((4 * tile, tile), dtype), B: T.Tensor((tile, tile), T.float32)):
            with T.Kernel(1, threads=128) as _:
                A_shared = T.alloc_shared((tile, tile), dtype)
                C_tmem = T.alloc_tmem((tile, tile), T.float32)
                C_frag = T.alloc_fragment((tile, tile), T.float32)
                if blockscaled:
                    SFA = T.alloc_tmem((tile, 4), T.uint32)
                    SFB = T.alloc_tmem((tile, 4), T.uint32)
    
                T.annotate_ws_schedule(
                    T.WSSchedule(
                        num_warps=8,
                        roles=[
                            T.WSRole("Producer", warps_lo=0, warps_hi=1, max_nreg=40),
                            T.WSRole("MMA", warps_lo=1, warps_hi=2, max_nreg=40),
                            T.WSRole("Epilogue", warps_lo=4, warps_hi=8, max_nreg=224),
                        ],
                        pipelines=[
                            T.WSPipeline("smem", [A_shared], depth=2),
                            T.WSPipeline("acc", [C_tmem], depth=1),
                        ],
                        scopes=[
                            T.WSScope(
                                "loop_k",
                                {
                                    "Producer": [
                                        T.WSSync.producer_acquire("smem"),
                                        "copy_in",
                                        T.WSSync.producer_commit("smem"),
                                    ],
                                    "MMA": [
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_wait("smem"),
                                        "gemm_C",
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_release("smem"),
                                    ],
                                    "Epilogue": [],
                                },
                            ),
                            T.WSScope(
                                T.WSScope.ROOT,
                                {
                                    "Producer": ["loop_k"],
                                    "MMA": [
                                        T.WSSync.producer_acquire("acc"),
                                        "loop_k",
                                        T.WSSync.producer_commit("acc"),
                                    ],
                                    "Epilogue": [
                                        "loop_k",
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_wait("acc"),
                                        "copy_C",
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_release("acc"),
                                        "copy_out",
                                    ],
                                },
                            ),
                        ],
                    )
                )
    
                for i in T.Pipelined(4, num_stages=2, annotations={T.WSID: "loop_k"}):
                    T.copy(A[i * tile, 0], A_shared, annotations={T.WSID: "copy_in"})
                    if blockscaled:
                        T.gemm_blockscaled(
                            A_shared,
                            A_shared,
                            C_tmem,
                            SFA,
                            SFB,
                            transpose_B=True,
                            clear_accum=i == 0,
                            k_start=i * tile,
                            sf_a_granularity_k=128,
                            sf_b_granularity_k=128,
                            annotations={T.WSID: "gemm_C"},
                        )
                    else:
                        T.gemm(
                            A_shared,
                            A_shared,
                            C_tmem,
                            transpose_B=True,
                            clear_accum=i == 0,
                            annotations={T.WSID: "gemm_C"},
                        )
                T.copy(C_tmem, C_frag, annotations={T.WSID: "copy_C"})
                T.copy(C_frag, B[0, 0], annotations={T.WSID: "copy_out"})

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda
    def test_guard_read_outside_span_rejected():
        """A buffer read only by an op's if-condition is an operand too: a
        guard reading a pipeline buffer after the role released it is
        rejected by the span-coverage check."""
    
        @T.prim_func
        def kernel(A: T.Tensor((256, 64), T.float16), B: T.Tensor((256, 64), T.float16)):
            with T.Kernel(1, threads=128) as _:
                A_shared = T.alloc_shared((64, 64), T.float16)
                A_frag = T.alloc_fragment((64, 64), T.float16)
    
                T.annotate_ws_schedule(
                    T.WSSchedule(
                        num_warps=8,
                        roles=[
                            T.WSRole("Producer", warps_lo=0, warps_hi=1, max_nreg=40),
                            T.WSRole("Consumer", warps_lo=4, warps_hi=8, max_nreg=224),
                        ],
                        pipelines=[T.WSPipeline("buf", [A_shared], depth=2)],
                        scopes=[
                            T.WSScope(
                                "loop_k",
                                {
                                    "Producer": [
                                        T.WSSync.producer_acquire("buf"),
                                        "copy_in",
                                        T.WSSync.producer_commit("buf"),
                                    ],
                                    "Consumer": [
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_wait("buf"),
                                        "copy_frag",
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_release("buf"),
                                        "copy_out",
                                    ],
                                },
                            ),
                            T.WSScope(T.WSScope.ROOT, {"Producer": ["loop_k"], "Consumer": ["loop_k"]}),
                        ],
                    )
                )
    
                for i in T.Pipelined(4, num_stages=2, annotations={T.WSID: "loop_k"}):
                    T.copy(A[i * 64, 0], A_shared, annotations={T.WSID: "copy_in"})
                    T.copy(A_shared, A_frag, annotations={T.WSID: "copy_frag"})
                    if A_shared[0, 0] > T.float16(0.0):
                        T.copy(A_frag, B[i * 64, 0], annotations={T.WSID: "copy_out"})

    def test_source_guard_follows_shifted_iteration():
        """The source guard of an op at a later stage is substituted with the
        op's shifted iteration — it is the only condition inside the
        steady-state loop, which carries no boundary checks of its own."""
    
        @T.prim_func
        def kernel(A: T.Tensor((256, 64), T.float16), B: T.Tensor((256, 64), T.float16)):
            with T.Kernel(1, threads=128) as _:
                A_shared = T.alloc_shared((32, 64), T.float16)
                C_shared = T.alloc_shared((32, 64), T.float16)
                A_frag = T.alloc_fragment((32, 64), T.float16)
                C_frag = T.alloc_fragment((32, 64), T.float16)
                T.annotate_ws_schedule(
                    T.WSSchedule(
                        num_warps=8,
                        roles=[
                            T.WSRole("Producer", warps_lo=0, warps_hi=1, max_nreg=40),
                            T.WSRole("Consumer", warps_lo=4, warps_hi=8, max_nreg=224),
                        ],
                        pipelines=[
                            T.WSPipeline("a", [A_shared], depth=2),
                            T.WSPipeline("c", [C_shared], depth=2),
                        ],
                        scopes=[
                            T.WSScope(
                                "loop_k",
                                {
                                    "Producer": [
                                        T.WSSync.producer_acquire("a", stage=0),
                                        "copy_a",
                                        T.WSSync.producer_commit("a", stage=0),
                                        T.WSSync.producer_acquire("c", stage=1),
                                        "copy_c",
                                        T.WSSync.producer_commit("c", stage=1),
                                    ],
                                    "Consumer": [
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_wait("a", stage=0),
                                        "read_a",
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_release("a", stage=0),
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_wait("c", stage=0),
                                        "read_c",
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_release("c", stage=0),
                                    ],
                                },
                            ),
                            T.WSScope(T.WSScope.ROOT, {"Producer": ["loop_k"], "Consumer": ["loop_k"]}),
                        ],
                    )
                )
    
                for i in T.Pipelined(4, num_stages=2, annotations={T.WSID: "loop_k"}):
                    T.copy(A[i * 32, 0], A_shared, annotations={T.WSID: "copy_a"})
                    if i < 3:
                        T.copy(A[i * 32, 0], C_shared, annotations={T.WSID: "copy_c"})
                    T.copy(A_shared, A_frag, annotations={T.WSID: "read_a"})
                    T.copy(C_shared, C_frag, annotations={T.WSID: "read_c"})

    @tilelang.testing.requires_cuda
    def test_capacity_deadlock_rejected():
        """Two roles produce into sibling scopes in opposite orders: each
        fills its pipeline's depth and blocks on an acquire that only the
        other's never-reached consumer scope would release. Surfaces only
        when loops are modeled past two iterations."""
    
        @T.prim_func
        def kernel(A: T.Tensor((256, 64), T.float16), B: T.Tensor((256, 64), T.float16)):
            with T.Kernel(1, threads=128) as _:
                S1 = T.alloc_shared((64, 64), T.float16)
                S2 = T.alloc_shared((64, 64), T.float16)
                F1 = T.alloc_fragment((64, 64), T.float16)
                F2 = T.alloc_fragment((64, 64), T.float16)
    
                T.annotate_ws_schedule(
                    T.WSSchedule(
                        num_warps=8,
                        roles=[
                            T.WSRole("Producer", warps_lo=0, warps_hi=1, max_nreg=40),
                            T.WSRole("Consumer", warps_lo=4, warps_hi=8, max_nreg=224),
                        ],
                        pipelines=[
                            T.WSPipeline("s1", [S1], depth=2),
                            T.WSPipeline("s2", [S2], depth=2),
                        ],
                        scopes=[
                            T.WSScope(
                                "loop_a",
                                {
                                    "Producer": [
                                        T.WSSync.producer_acquire("s1"),
                                        "copy_in1",
                                        T.WSSync.producer_commit("s1"),
                                    ],
                                    "Consumer": [
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_wait("s1"),
                                        "copy_frag1",
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_release("s1"),
                                        "copy_out1",
                                    ],
                                },
                            ),
                            T.WSScope(
                                "loop_b",
                                {
                                    "Consumer": [
                                        T.WSSync.producer_acquire("s2"),
                                        "copy_in2",
                                        T.WSSync.producer_commit("s2"),
                                    ],
                                    "Producer": [
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_wait("s2"),
                                        "copy_frag2",
                                        T.WSSync.consumer_release("s2"),
                                        "copy_out2",
                                    ],

                                {

        output = tirx.decl_buffer((4,), "float32", name="output", scope="global")
        enabled = tirx.Var("enabled", "bool")
        active = tirx.Var("active", "bool")
    
        def region(buffer, mask):
            indices = [0] * len(buffer.shape)
            return tirx.Call(
                "handle",
                tvm.ir.Op.get("tl.region"),
                [buffer[tuple(indices)], mask, *buffer.shape],
            )
    
        def copy(src, dst):
            return tirx.Evaluate(
                tirx.Call(
                    "handle",
                    tvm.ir.Op.get("tl.tileop.copy"),
                    [region(src, 1), region(dst, 2)],
                )
            )
    
        def unit(body, source_id, op_id, *, guard=None):
            stmt = tirx.AttrStmt({"ws_op_id": op_id}, "tl.cuda_task", 1, body)
            if guard is not None:
                stmt = tirx.IfThenElse(guard, stmt, None)
            return tirx.AttrStmt(
                {"stage": 0, "source_id": source_id}, "tl.schedule_unit", 1, stmt
            )
    
        def owner(index, extent):
            iv = tirx.Var(f"i{index}", "int32")
            children = [
                unit(copy(source, shared), 10 + index * 10, f"load{index}", guard=active),
                unit(copy(shared, output), 11 + index * 10, f"store{index}", guard=active),

            loop = tirx.For(
                iv,
                0,
                extent,
                tirx.ForKind.SERIAL,
                tirx.SeqStmt(children),
                annotations={"tl.ws_op_id": f"owner{index}"},
            )
            return tirx.AttrStmt(
                {"stage": 0, "source_id": 20 + index * 10}, "tl.schedule_unit", 1, loop
            )

            [],

            },
